subject.title: feat(ios): read-only offline cache for chat sessions and transcripts

question: Should the iOS app ship a persisted per-gateway read-only transcript/session cache once the request-scope bug is fixed and live proof is posted?
rationale: This PR adds a new on-device conversation cache and has a protected maintainer label; automation can identify the scope bug and proof gap, but a maintainer must accept the security/product boundary before merge.

options.title: Fix scope, then require live proof
options.body: Bind session-cache writes to the request gateway, remove the release-owned changelog hunk, and require redacted simulator/device evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept with explicit security sign-off
options.body: A maintainer can choose to accept the persisted cache boundary after reviewing file protection, purge behavior, and remaining proof gaps.

options.title: Pause behind the parent cache issue
options.body: Keep this branch open but do not land until the broader mobile offline cache scope is settled through the parent issue and stacked platform PRs.

recommendation.title: Fix scope, then require live proof
recommendation.body: Bind session-cache writes to the request gateway, remove the release-owned changelog hunk, and require redacted simulator/device evidence before merge.
